sources.entry: FileMint - Native Finder extension for creating files from the right-click menu with templates; free for personal and non-commercial use. ![Native App][Native Icon]

summary.one_liner: FileMint is a native macOS Finder extension that creates files (Markdown, Word, Excel and custom templates) from the right-click menu, plus optional batch rename, checksum, image and OCR tools.
summary.what_it_does: FileMint adds a New File submenu to Finder's right-click menu on configured folders, letting you create files from reusable templates such as Markdown, Word (.docx) and Excel (.xlsx) documents. The New File... dialog lets you set the full filename, extension, destination and starter content before creating the file. Optional File & Folder Tools cover copying names and paths, moving items, copying file contents, previewing templates, and creating files from plain-text clipboard items. Batch Rename previews and renames multiple items in one directory, and File Info calculates SHA-256 and other supported digests. Optional Resource Tools handle image conversion, compression, resizing, icon set generation, stitching, OCR text extraction and removal of private metadata. The README states that file creation and image processing run locally and that the Finder extension works offline.
use_cases: create a markdown note in the current Finder folder
make blank Word or Excel files from the right-click menu
batch rename files in a folder
compute SHA-256 checksums of a file
extract text from images with OCR
strip GPS and camera metadata from photos
save a clipboard screenshot as a PNG file
how_to_run: Download the latest DMG from the project's releases and drag FileMint into Applications.
Launch FileMint, enable the Finder extension in macOS System Settings.
Authorize your working folders in FileMint's File Access settings.
Or install via Homebrew: brew install --cask filemintapp/tap/filemint
stack: macOS system OCR and HEIC encoder
notable: Creates files from a Finder folder's right-click New File menu with reusable, multiple templates per format
Imports user Word and Excel documents as templates and creates independent copies
Runs file creation, image processing and OCR on the local Mac; no uploads, no background folder crawling
Optional File and Resource Tools start disabled so the existing New File menu is undisturbed
Shortcuts and Raycast integration for opening prefilled drafts (macOS 13.3+)
caveats: Installers support only M-series Macs on macOS 13.0 or later; Intel compatibility is covered separately in the notes
Commercial use requires separate written authorization or a paid commercial license; not MIT despite public source
Requires enabling the Finder extension in System Settings and authorizing folders
Some roadmap items (Homebrew upgrade/migration, troubleshooting, template groups) are unfinished
summary.license: FileMint Non-Commercial Source License (personal and non-commercial use free; commercial use requires authorization)
